description: t.a spawns a server and links it to t.peer (the server's task holds the link, propagating). The driver cancels the region at 200 ns: the server stops through its terminate hook and its task is spawned from a poll that acknowledged a cancel after its first poll, so its join keeps the value it returned (Ok, the snapshot), while its record, which held the cancel request, completes Cancelled: the exit is an abnormal one and the link cancels t.peer with a linked-exit reason.
